name: gravesai-agent
description: Graves Continuum UPM platform + Thomas process agent

scripts.dev: npm run dev -w @thomas/api & npm run dev -w @thomas/feeder & npm run dev -w @thomas/visuals
scripts.build:continuum: npm run build -w @graves/upm-shared && npm run build -w @graves/bio-engines && npm run build -w @graves/continuum-api && npm run build -w @graves/continuum
scripts.build: npm run build:continuum && npm run build -w @thomas/shared && npm run build -w @thomas/api && npm run build -w @thomas/feeder && npm run build -w @thomas/visuals
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @graves/upm-shared && npm run typecheck -w @graves/bio-engines && npm run typecheck -w @graves/continuum-api && npm run typecheck -w @graves/continuum && npm run typecheck -w @thomas/shared && npm run typecheck -w @thomas/api && npm run typecheck -w @thomas/feeder && npm run typecheck -w @thomas/visuals
